answer: The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a sable seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under. The timber receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. Sustaining that many identities means writing fresh texts against a target that moves every epoch, thus the work cannot be batched or cached in advance. Collateral of 93 dollars is at risk. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
